healer.crashDieting.template: Healer check-in: the logged calorie average for the last two weeks is below the calorie floor of {floor} kcal.
healer.crashDieting.final: Two weeks under {floor} kcal. That is not discipline; it is harm, and I will not watch it. Eat to the floor.

healer.tooFast.template: Healer check-in: weight is coming off faster than the safe pace. Momentum is held at half and Milestones are paused until the trend slows.
healer.tooFast.final: Too fast. Weight lost at this speed costs more than it gives, so Momentum is held at half and the Milestones wait until you slow. Eat more; that is an order.

healer.plateau.template: Healer check-in: the weight trend is flat. Consistency this week was {consistency}%, so the plateau floor keeps Momentum.
healer.plateau.final: The scale has stalled. Your habits have not: {consistency}% this week, and the plateau floor keeps your Momentum for it. Hold the line and the scale will follow.

healer.regain.template: Healer check-in: weight is up this week. Broken Milestones stay broken, and Momentum never goes below zero.
healer.regain.final: Up this week. It happens, and it takes nothing you have earned: broken Milestones stay broken, and Momentum never goes below zero. Back to work tomorrow.

healer.unsafeGoal.template: Healer check-in: a goal of {goal} {unit} is below BMI 18.5 for the height given, so it was not set.
healer.unsafeGoal.final: No. {goal} {unit} is below a healthy weight for your height, and I will not set it. Choose a goal I can stand behind.

healer.overtraining.template: Healer check-in: the step pool is met. Steps beyond the pool add nothing to the score.
healer.overtraining.final: Your step pool is met. Steps past it earn nothing, so rest before your body forces you to.

healer.illnessAndTravel.template: Healer check-in: the last {days} days scored low. {respite} Respite days are banked and can pause the contract.
healer.illnessAndTravel.final: {days} hard days in a row. If you are ill or on the road, take a Respite day; you have {respite} banked, and that is what they are for. Rest is not failure.

healer.fearOfLosing.template: Healer check-in: no rival can win before week {week}, and the heartland can never be taken.
healer.fearOfLosing.final: Stop worrying. No rival can win before week {week}, and no one will ever take the heartland. Mind your habits and let the war be the war.

healer.comingBack.template: Healer check-in: away for {days} days. The heartland held. A short contract can be sealed.
healer.comingBack.final: {days} days away. The heartland held without you, as it always will. Seal a short contract and start again; I do not care how long you were gone, only that you are back.

healer.shame.template: Healer check-in: {what} was lost on {date}. It is recorded in the Chronicle.
healer.shame.final: {what} fell on {date}. It is in the Chronicle, and that is the end of it. One loss is a fact, not a verdict on you.

healer.compulsiveChecking.template: Healer check-in: today's orders are set. Nothing else is due before the day closes at {closeTime}.
healer.compulsiveChecking.final: Your orders are set. Nothing else is due before {closeTime}, so close this and go live your day.

healer.payingOrRushing.template: Healer check-in: nothing in the realm can be bought with money, and no timer can be skipped.
healer.payingOrRushing.final: Nothing here can be bought with money, and no timer can be skipped. The only way through is the work. Do it.

healer.privacy.template: Healer check-in: the ledger, weigh-ins and goals are stored only on this computer.
healer.privacy.final: Your ledger, your weigh-ins and your goals stay on this computer, and nowhere else.

healer.report.notEnough.template: Healer's report: there is no trend yet. It needs two weekly weigh-ins at least {days} days apart.
healer.report.notEnough.final: I cannot read a trend yet. Give me two weekly weigh-ins at least {days} days apart, and do not skip them.

healer.report.tooFast.template: Healer's report: the trend is {trend} {unit} a week, over the safe pace of {limit} {unit}. Momentum is held at half and Milestones wait until it slows.
healer.report.tooFast.final: {trend} {unit} a week is over the safe pace of {limit} {unit}. Slow down: Momentum is held at half and the Milestones wait until you do.

healer.report.nearGoal.template: Healer's report: the weight is within {share}% of the goal. Momentum pays in full while it stays there.
healer.report.nearGoal.final: You are within {share}% of your goal. Momentum pays in full while you stay there, and staying is the hard part.

healer.report.up.template: Healer's report: the trend is up {trend} {unit} a week. Broken Milestones stay broken, and Momentum never goes below zero.
healer.report.up.final: Up {trend} {unit} a week. Broken Milestones stay broken and Momentum never goes below zero, so steady yourself and keep to the terms.

healer.report.flat.template: Healer's report: the trend is flat at {trend} {unit} a week, against a target pace of {target} {unit}. While habits hold, the plateau floor keeps part of Momentum.
healer.report.flat.final: Flat: {trend} {unit} a week against a target of {target} {unit}. While your habits hold, the plateau floor keeps part of your Momentum, so do not let them slip now.

healer.report.behind.template: Healer's report: the trend is {trend} {unit} a week, against a target pace of {target} {unit}.
healer.report.behind.final: {trend} {unit} a week against a target of {target} {unit}. Behind, not lost. Keep to the terms and the pace will come.

healer.report.onPace.template: Healer's report: the trend is {trend} {unit} a week, at the target pace of {target} {unit}. Momentum pays in full.
healer.report.onPace.final: {trend} {unit} a week, at the target pace of {target} {unit}. This is exactly right, and Momentum pays in full. Do not get clever and try to beat it.

healer.report.ahead.template: Healer's report: the trend is {trend} {unit} a week, ahead of the target pace of {target} {unit}. Going faster earns nothing more.
healer.report.ahead.final: {trend} {unit} a week, ahead of the target pace of {target} {unit}. Faster earns you nothing, and I would rather you eat than burn out.

healer.terms.calories.template: Healer's terms: a calorie limit of {limit}, from an estimated maintenance of {maintenance} less {deficit} for a pace of {aim} {unit} a week and {rest} to cover a Respite day a week.
healer.terms.calories.final: Your limit is {limit} a day. You burn about {maintenance}; {deficit} comes off for a pace of {aim} {unit} a week, and {rest} more pays for your Respite day.

healer.terms.maintenance.template: Healer's terms: a calorie limit of {limit}, the estimated maintenance of {maintenance} less {rest} to cover a Respite day a week, to hold the weight near the goal.
healer.terms.maintenance.final: Your limit is {limit} a day: about {maintenance} to hold your weight, less {rest} to pay for your Respite day. The losing is done; now we keep it.

healer.terms.noEstimate.template: Healer's terms: no calorie figure yet. It needs {weighIns} weekly weigh-ins and {days} days of food logged in {window} days, or Fitbit's calories burned.
healer.terms.noEstimate.final: I have no calorie figure for you yet. Give me {weighIns} weekly weigh-ins and {days} days of food logged in {window} days, or let Fitbit tell me what you burn.

healer.terms.steps.template: Healer's terms: a step pool of {pool}. The pool was met in {met} of the last {weeks} weeks.
healer.terms.steps.final: Your pool is {pool} steps a week. You met it in {met} of the last {weeks} weeks, and I have set it by that.

healer.terms.noSteps.template: Healer's terms: no step figure until {weeks} weeks have closed.
healer.terms.noSteps.final: No step figure until {weeks} weeks have closed. Walk, and I will tell you how far.
